skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: One Blade
skins.content: 0011 Tempest Series New Arrivals/One Blade. Form-fitting, cool, and breathable sportswear, for those patrolling the streets. In a fistfight, the flowing scarlet sleeves become a raging flame. The accompanying sword is most certainly not a prop.
skins.quote: He himself was not as brash as his outfit, and he took out his sword only to take photos. But even with only a single blade, when it came time to help others, he did not doubt himself for a second.

skins.name: Holiday HDm04
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HDm04. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
skins.quote: Better setting out than knives out, on a bright, sunny day like this.
